title: Malluch
sourceLines: -2. Son of Bani, who divorced his Gentile wife after the captivity Ezr 10:29
-3. One of the family of Harim, who divorced his Gentile wife after the captivity Ezr 10:32
-4. A priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah Ne 10:4; 12:2
-5. A chief of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah Ne 10:27
